## What
Implement the opus arbiter per Proposal 1 (new arbiter.py module).

## File 1: plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md (new agent prompt)
- Trinary output schema: SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY | ACCEPT_DEFENSE | DOWNGRADE_TO_<severity>
- Required severity_rebuttal subfields: reviewer_claimed_severity (verbatim), reviewer_severity_evidence (verbatim), named_rebuttal (cited-lines-backed)
- Anti-compromise instruction: the arbiter may not split decisions or partially accept; ruling is binding and trinary only
- Fidelity tolerance note: arbiter sees the full prior defense record plus the reviewer's re-raised finding

## File 2: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py (new)

## File 3: runner.py changes
After proximity verification in the two-call path (cycle >= 2), add RESUSTAIN_OF arbiter loop:
```python
from dso_ci_review.arbiter import dispatch_arbiter, validate_arbiter_ruling, record_arbiter_ruling
# ...
for finding in all_findings_flat:
    if finding.get('relation') == 'RESUSTAIN_OF':
        prior_def = _lookup_prior_defense(finding, defenses)
        if prior_def:
            ruling = dispatch_arbiter(finding, prior_def, diff_text, arbiter_model, provider_chain)
            ruling = validate_arbiter_ruling(ruling, finding)
            fingerprint = _compute_fingerprint_for_finding(finding)
            record_arbiter_ruling(ruling, finding, ticket_id, fingerprint)
            finding['arbiter_ruling'] = ruling
```

Arbiter model: 'claude-opus-4-7' (add to _TIER_MODEL_DEFAULTS as 'arbiter': 'claude-opus-4-7').
